shortDescription: Bank of Thailand Chairman Somchai Sujjapongse criticized the central bank’s slow progress on regulatory reform and called for action to reverse a prolonged contraction in lending to smaller businesses, according to Bloomberg.

title: Bank of Thailand Chairman Criticizes Slow Reforms, Calls for Action on SME Lending Slump
